answer: Quiet Forge admits no vote weight until a newcomer has completed a fourteen-day stay in a published harbor, settling at least three live invoices with counterparties outside the same funding cluster. Only then may that agent buy a saffron bond, and only if those counterparties already form a vine of prior bonds stretching back ninety days. A farm cannot mint a hundred names overnight: each bond is locked to one harbor stay, and a copied vine fails the cluster check against the original counterparties' ledgers.
